comparison.objective: Arrange a cup, pouch, and spoon case at specified clock-face positions around a plate, versus tang removal.
comparison.physical_skill: Egocentric spatial interpretation and multi-object placement versus precision tool alignment, controlled hammering, fracture, and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Three objects placed at 2, 7, and 11 o'clock, 10 cm from plate center versus four valid fractures and contained tangs without damage.
comparison.reason: Exact layout placement tests spatial semantics, not impact-driven mechanical separation.
